Grade 5 — Math

Weekly Pacing Guide 2026-27 · three strands, one map · W01–W39

1. How the pacing works

Three strands, one map. Standard teaches every step (~4 new per week); Priority (~3) and Intervention (~2) teach fewer, paced evenly inside each block, with the remaining days as support blocks. Every strand covers every essential step and all strands finish each block together, so a class or a child can change strand at any block boundary.

Yellow = power standard. BUILD = CCSS custom lesson still to be written. Pink = support block, pick one. Blue CCSS chips are on-grade (5.x); cream chips are off-grade coverage.

Every step links to its White Rose lesson, with slides, worksheets, answers, teaching guide, TA materials and video alongside. Math pacing starts in the second week of school. W01 is 6–10 Sep; the first week (30 Aug – 3 Sep) is left free to settle classes and run the baseline tasks. So pacing week Wnn sits in weekly plan week nn+1: the weekly plans carry W01–W34 (plan weeks 2–35); W35–W39 appear on this page only, since the weekly plans stop at week 35. Every support block lists real lower-grade lessons from Reception/PK4 up to Year 5/Grade 4, earliest first.
